title: sorbus aria f. buekkensis
intro: Sorbus aria f. buekkensis, commonly known as the Békés whitebeam, is a subspecies of the whitebeam tree, which is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree that is native to Hungary and is valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties. The health benefits of Sorbus aria f. buekkensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
